verdict.rationale: HubSpot's connected inbox and Sequences tool explicitly let sales/ops users send one-to-one templated emails and multi-step, timed email sequences directly from the CRM, with replies logged automatically. This is a core, well-documented first-party feature (docs-13/21/46, docs-37/44) rather than a third-party workaround. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification beyond vendor docs.
